name: comp-512

frames.best_why: Button reads Nov 07 - Nov 18 with the matching range shaded inside the open calendar.

tagline: Labelled button that opens a calendar for picking two dates.
summary: A form field labelled Date range picker: an outlined button showing Pick a date range and a small calendar glyph. Opening it reveals a month calendar where two clicks shade a span and rewrite the button text.
appearance: A small label sits above a full-width dark outlined button that holds grey placeholder text on the left and a calendar icon on the right. Below, a floating rounded panel shows a month with weekday initials, day numbers, and a grey band with white circular ends for the range.
behaviour: Pressing the button drops the calendar open beneath it. A first click sets the start, a second sets the end and the button text becomes something like Nov 07, 2026 - Nov 18, 2026; the panel stays open until dismissed.
demo_content: November 2026 with a range from 7 to 18 chosen; caption reads "Built with React DayPicker".
search_phrases: date range button that opens a calendar
pick start and end dates in a popup
form field showing chosen date range
date filter button with calendar icon
popup month calendar for two dates
field that shows one date to another
range selector in a floating panel
use_when: A form needs a compact date range field that stays collapsed until someone opens it.
avoid_when: Only one month shows at a time and a long range label can be truncated inside a narrow field.
customise: The label, placeholder and caption are written in the file; button width, popover alignment and date format are also fixed in the source.
weight_why: A button and one month calendar that only renders while the popover is open.

a11y.note: The trigger has a linked label and a visible focus outline and days are buttons, but the range is only read as plain button text.

issues: The open popover sits on top of its own caption text in the frames.
Only one month is visible, so ranges over a month edge take extra clicks.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of the control.
polish_why: Neat labelled trigger and clean calendar; the panel covering its own caption is a small flaw.
title: Date Range Popover Picker
